_note: English source for every email sent to students and teachers. {placeholders} are filled by the server; **text** becomes bold. Plan names (Community, Focused, Intensive, Private) are product names and stay as they are.

common.footer_account: You received this email because you have an Alimun account.
common.footer_newsletter: You received this email because you signed up for news and offers on alimun.com.

reset.subject: Choose a new Alimun password
reset.preheader: Use the button in this email to choose a new password for your Alimun account.
reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password of the Alimun account for this email address. Use the button below to choose a new one.
reset.note: The link works once and only for a limited time. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
reset.footer: You received this email because a password reset was requested for this address on alimun.com.

invite.subject: Your Alimun account
invite.preheader: Your Alimun account is ready. Choose a password to sign in.
invite.heading: Your Alimun account is ready
invite.body_teacher: Alimun has opened a teacher account for you. Choose your password with the button below and you go straight to your teacher dashboard.
invite.body_student: Alimun has opened a student account for you. Choose your password with the button below, then take the short level test and start learning.
invite.note: The link works once and only for a limited time. If it has expired, use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page with this email address.
invite.footer: You received this email because an Alimun administrator opened an account for this address.

approved.subject: Welcome to Alimun, {name}
approved.preheader: Your Alimun teacher account is ready.
approved.heading: Welcome to Alimun
approved.body: Your application to teach with Alimun has been approved, and your account is ready. Sign in to set up your classes and welcome your first students.
approved.footer: You received this email because you applied to teach with Alimun.

rejected.subject: About your application to teach with Alimun
rejected.preheader: An update on your application to teach with Alimun.
rejected.heading: About your application
rejected.body: Thank you for applying to teach with Alimun. After reviewing your application, we are not able to approve it at this time.
rejected.body2: We appreciate the time you put into it and wish you all the best with your teaching.
rejected.footer: This email was sent to {email} because you applied to teach with Alimun.

suspended.subject: Your Alimun teacher account
suspended.preheader: Your Alimun teacher account has been suspended.
suspended.heading: Your teacher account is suspended
suspended.body: Your Alimun teacher account has been suspended, so the teacher dashboard is no longer available to you.
suspended.body2: If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email and we will look into it.
suspended.footer: You received this email because you have a teacher account on Alimun.

session.cancelled: Your **{class}** session on **{when}** has been cancelled.
session.moved: Your **{class}** session on {was} has moved to **{when}**.
session.opens: The classroom opens in your dashboard 15 minutes before the new start time.

class_new.subject: Your class: {class}
class_new.heading: Your new class
class_new.body: You are now in the **{class}** class with **{teacher}**.
class_new.body2: Your dashboard shows the schedule and your next session.

class_left.subject: Your Alimun class
class_left.heading: Your class has changed
class_left.body: You are no longer in the **{class}** class.
class_left.body2: You can choose a new class from your dashboard, or reply to this email if you have questions.

enrolled.subject: You're in: {class} with {teacher}
enrolled.heading: You're in
enrolled.body: You have joined the **{class}** class with **{teacher}**.
enrolled.soon: soon: your dashboard shows the schedule
enrolled.opens: The classroom opens in your dashboard 15 minutes before the start.
enrolled.footer: You received this email because you joined a class on Alimun.

student_joined.subject: A new student joined your class
student_joined.heading: A new student joined your class
student_joined.body: A new student joined your **{class}** class.
student_joined.footer: You received this email because you teach this class on Alimun.

place.subject: A place is open in your {class} class
place.preheader: A place has opened in the class you were waiting for. It is held for you for 48 hours.
place.heading: A place is open for you
place.body: A place has opened in the class you were waiting for. You were first on the waiting list, so it is held for you for the next **48 hours**.
place.note: If you do not claim it within 48 hours, the place goes to the next person on the waiting list.
place.footer: You received this email because you joined the waiting list for this class on Alimun.

notes.subject: Session notes ready: {class}, {date}
notes.preheader: Your notes from {date} are in your dashboard.
notes.heading: Your session notes are ready
notes.body: Your notes from the **{class}** session on **{date}** are ready.
notes.footer: You received this email because you are in this class on Alimun.

sub_ended.subject: Your Alimun subscription has ended
sub_ended.heading: Your subscription has ended
sub_ended.body: Your subscription has ended and your seat in your class has been released. Your access continues until **{date}**.
sub_ended.body2: You can subscribe again at any time from your dashboard to rejoin a class. Thank you for studying with us.
sub_ended.footer: You received this email because you had an Alimun subscription.

pay_cancelled.subject: Your Alimun subscription has been cancelled
pay_cancelled.preheader: We could not take your payment, so your subscription was cancelled.
pay_cancelled.heading: Your subscription has been cancelled
pay_cancelled.body: We could not take your payment after three attempts, so your subscription has been cancelled and your class seat released.
pay_cancelled.body2: To come back, sign in, update your payment method and subscribe again.
pay_cancelled.footer: You received this email because you have an Alimun subscription.

pay_failed.subject: Your Alimun payment did not go through
pay_failed.preheader: Update your payment method to keep your seat.
pay_failed.heading: Your payment did not go through
pay_failed.body: We could not take your latest subscription payment. Update your payment method in your dashboard billing settings to keep your seat.
pay_failed.body2: We will try again automatically in a few days.
pay_failed.footer: You received this email because you have an Alimun subscription.

plan.subject: Your Alimun plan is now {plan}
plan.preheader: Your account is now on the {plan} plan.
plan.heading: Your plan has changed
plan.body: The Alimun team has moved your account to the **{plan}** plan. It is active now, with no card or payment needed.
plan.body2: Sign in to see your classes and exercises.
plan.note: If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email.

admin_app.subject: New teacher application: {name}
admin_app.heading: New teacher application
admin_app.body: A teacher has applied. Review the details and decide with the buttons below; each button asks you to confirm.
admin_app.note: The buttons work for seven days. You can also decide in the admin dashboard.
admin_app.footer: Sent to the Alimun admin address when a teacher applies.

contact.subject: Contact form: {name}
contact.heading: Message from {name}
contact.note: Reply to this email to answer them directly.
contact.footer: Sent from the contact form on alimun.com.

unsub.text_bad: The link may be incomplete. You can also stop news and offers in your dashboard, under Settings.
unsub.text_ask: You will no longer receive news and offers from Alimun. Emails about your account and your classes still arrive.
unsub.text_done: You will no longer receive news and offers from Alimun. You can turn them back on at any time in your dashboard, under Settings.
unsub.text_done_newsletter: You will no longer receive news and offers from Alimun. To sign up again, use the form at the bottom of any page on alimun.com.
unsub.text_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute.

decide.err_secret: This link cannot be used right now. Please decide in the admin dashboard.
decide.err_expired: This link is invalid or has expired. Please decide in the admin dashboard.
decide.err_db: The database could not be reached.
decide.err_update: The teacher profile could not be updated.
decide.already_declined: **{name}** has already been declined or suspended.
decide.done_declined: The application from **{name}** has been declined and the account marked as suspended.
decide.emailed: A notification email has been sent to **{email}**.
decide.not_emailed: The notification email could not be sent.

withdrawal.subject: We received your withdrawal
withdrawal.heading: We received your withdrawal
withdrawal.body: We received your withdrawal on **{when}**. This email is your confirmation.
withdrawal.refund: We will refund what you paid within 14 days, to the payment method you used. If you asked for classes to start during the withdrawal period, the classes already given are deducted. If the purchase is a subscription, we end it; you do not need to cancel it yourself.
withdrawal.footer: You received this email because you withdrew from a purchase on alimun.com.

rooms.footer: You get this email because you reserved or teach a room at Alimun.

room_cancelled.subject: Your room will not start on {start}
room_cancelled.heading: Your room will not start
room_cancelled.body: Not enough learners joined **{room}** starting on {start} ({days} at {time}, {zone}), so it will not open.
room_cancelled.body2: Nothing has been charged and your reservation has ended. You can choose another time or the next start date, and your founding price stays yours.

room_merged.subject: Your room has a new time
room_merged.heading: Your room has a new time
room_merged.body: Your room joined another room at the same level so that it can open: **{room}**, starting on {start}, {days} at {time} ({zone}).
room_merged.body2: Nothing has been charged yet; your card is charged on the first day. If the new time does not suit you, reply to this email before then and we cancel your reservation.

contract_offer.subject: Course contract offered: {room}
contract_offer.heading: A room is ready for you
contract_offer.body: **{room}** opens with {learners} learners, starting on {start}, {days} at {time} ({zone}), for 12 weeks.
contract_offer.body2: This is a separate course contract that you may accept or decline, without any consequence for future offers. Please answer from your dashboard.

room_not_opening.subject: {room} from {start} will not open
room_not_opening.heading: This room will not open
room_not_opening.body: **{room}** starting on {start} ({days} at {time}, {zone}) will not open: not enough learners joined, or the learners moved to another room.
room_not_opening.body2: Thank you for offering this time. Rooms you can teach will come to you as new offers.

room_published.subject: A room at your level is open: {room}
room_published.heading: A room is open at your level
room_published.body2: You asked us to tell you, or you reserved a place without choosing a room. Choose this room in your dashboard while places are left.

founding_notice.subject: Your founding price ends on {date}
founding_notice.heading: Your founding price ends on {date}
founding_notice.body: You joined Alimun at the founding price, and it is kept for you until **{date}**. After that, new purchases are at the usual price shown in Plans and prices; a pack you are already in keeps its price to its end.
founding_notice.body2: Nothing changes before then, and nothing is charged because of this email.

class_late.subject_t: Your {class} class started at {time}: your learners are waiting
class_late.body_t: Your **{class}** class was due to start at {time} and you are not in the room yet. Please join now; your learners have been told you are on your way.
class_late.subject_l: Your teacher is running a few minutes late
class_late.heading_l: Your teacher is on the way
class_late.body_l: Your **{class}** class was due to start at {time}. Your teacher is running a few minutes late and has been told. Please stay in the room or come back in a few minutes.

class_remind.heading_60: Your class starts in an hour
class_remind.body_60: Your **{class}** class starts at {time}. Check in when you are ready, at least 5 minutes before it starts, so we know you are there.
class_remind.subject_5: Check in now: your {class} class starts at {time}
class_remind.body_5_missing: Your **{class}** class starts at {time} and you have not checked in yet. Check in now and open the classroom; your learners will be waiting.
class_remind.body_5_ok: Your **{class}** class starts at {time}. You are checked in: open the classroom now.
